description: Analyzes nccl-tests / rccl-tests results (paste raw all_reduce_perf output, or give size/busbw points). Detects node and GPU counts from the output, compares large-message bus bandwidth with the fabric's NIC line rate (InfiniBand HDR/NDR/XDR, RoCE 100G to 800G), and flags data errors, degraded bandwidth, dips as message size grows and unstable run-to-run results, with likely causes. Returns a health status and a bandwidth-loss figure for calculate_fabric_degradation_cost.

collective.description: Collective that was benchmarked. Default all_reduce.

expected_busbw_gbs.description: Expected healthy bus bandwidth in GB/s, e.g. from an acceptance test. Overrides the line-rate reference; required to judge single-node runs.

fabric.description: Inter-node fabric and per-port speed. Use 'other' with link_gbps for anything else.

gpus_per_node.description: GPUs per node. Detected from raw_output when omitted; default 8.

link_gbps.description: Per-NIC link speed in Gb/s. Overrides the speed implied by fabric.

nics_per_node.description: Compute-fabric NICs per node (rails). Default: one per GPU.

nodes.description: Number of nodes in the run. Detected from raw_output when omitted.

raw_output.description: Raw stdout of an nccl-tests or rccl-tests run (e.g. all_reduce_perf -b 8 -e 8G -f 2 -g 1). Paste it unchanged; rank/host lines are used to detect node count.

results.description: Alternative to raw_output: measured points as {size_bytes, busbw_gbs}.

busbw_gbs.description: Bus bandwidth in GB/s, as nccl-tests reports it.

name: analyze_nccl_benchmark
title: NCCL Benchmark Analyzer
